items.summary: Add a `getEnergySnapshot` query method to the equipa canister (backend/main.mo or the equipa canister source) that aggregates all cached device data and returns a record containing: total power (sum of all cached device power values), active device count (number of devices with cached data), average carbon intensity (average of all cached carbon values), current cycle cost (from the existing cycleCost state variable), and a timestamp (current time or latest cached timestamp).
